description: The Reg Monitoring monthly briefing: an editor-written round-up of the most important financial services regulatory updates of one month, grouped by region (North America; UK and Europe; Asia-Pacific, Middle East and Africa), with a one-line overview per region and the deadlines in the 60 days after it was sent. Use for "what happened in regulation last month" or "catch me up", where a curated summary beats a raw search. Omit `month` for the latest issue. The response includes how to receive the briefing by email each month.

month.description: The month the issue covers, as YYYY-MM (e.g. "2026-10"). Omit for the latest issue. Each issue covers the previous calendar month.

name: regmonitoring_get_monthly_briefing
title: Get monthly briefing
